// diagnostic E0701

Jet.MissingCrateVersion

Non-`std` `extern rust` crate missing `@version` pin

What

Non-`std` `extern rust` crate missing `@version` pin

Why

A foreign crate must pin an exact version so every build uses the same code

Fix

Add an `@version` pin to the non-`std` `extern rust` crate.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MissingCrateVersion: Tests/UI/ffi_missing_version.stderr.

Error: Jet.MissingCrateVersion: The crate `base64` needs a version pin
  --> Tests/UI/ffi_missing_version.jet:1:13
    |
  1 | extern rust "base64" {
    |             ^^^^^^^^
 Why: Every non-`std` `extern rust` crate must pin an exact version so builds stay reproducible
 Fix: Write `extern rust "base64@0.1" { ... }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.MissingCrateVersion
